comparison.objective: Clear two loose cups while identifying and leaving an indistinguishable stuck cup.
comparison.physical_skill: Low-force probing, latent attachment discrimination, and safe cup transport.
comparison.success_condition: Both loose cups upright in the tray; stuck cup moves no more than 3 mm; no tipping or falls.
comparison.reason: Tests force-limited attachment diagnosis, not coaxial tool alignment, hammering, fracture, or fragment recovery. Specs are absent, but body thresholds suffice.
